name: matts-logistics-updated
title: Matt's Logistics: Updated
author: CG-Matt (original); johnmart19 / FactorioMods (2.1 fork)
description: Additional belt tiers, long underground pipes and larger substations. With Space Age, vanilla turbo belts, underground belts and splitters can also be crafted in fluid-capable assemblers without a planet restriction. Belts, pipes and substations can be enabled separately in startup settings. Original mod by CG-Matt.
